description:
You are a Computer Systems Analyst at TailwindTraders responsible for tracking software quality. A recent project audit revealed that several critical bugs are unassigned (no owner), misrouted to the wrong area path, and there is no saved query for leadership to track the bug backlog at a glance.

Your goals:
1. Investigate the work item backlog to identify which Priority 1 bugs are currently unassigned
2. Assign each unassigned Priority 1 bug to an available team member (use 'Docker' as the team member)
3. Correct the area path for any bugs that are categorized under the wrong area — Priority 1 bugs should be under 'TailwindTraders\\Backend API', not 'TailwindTraders\\Uncategorized'
4. Create a new shared team query called 'Critical Bug Backlog' that returns all Active bugs with Priority 1, saved under Shared Queries
5. Add the tag 'needs-owner' to any work items that were unassigned at the start, to document the gap

Login URL: http://localhost/DefaultCollection
Username: Docker
Password: GymAnything123!
